We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have to produce a JSON route with 5 reactions. Need to find appropriate templates. We have one template (29646) that deprotects TBS? Actually template 29646 is deprotection: converts TBS-protected alcohol to free alcohol (break TBS, form OH). It matches our target? The apply gave three possible precursors: each with TBS group attached to some OH. The product is target with free OH? Wait target has OH groups: there is O at start (hydroxy on ring) and O in side chain? The target includes O[C@H]1... and also a carboxylic acid at end. The template seems to replace a TBS-protected O with OH. The product (target) is free OH; the reactant includes TBS group attached to O. So step 1 could be deprotection of TBS to give protected precursor.

Thus retrosynthesis step 1: target -> protected precursor (with TBS). That's a forward reaction of TBS protection; retrosynthetic step is deprotection. So we can use template 29646 (retro: remove TBS). Good.

Now we need to further break down the protected precursor. The protected precursor from apply_template gave three options. Choose one that seems plausible for further steps. Let's examine first product from apply: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO' This has a TBS on the carboxylic acid? Actually O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C attached to the carboxylate O (ester). That's a TBS ester of the acid? That's unusual. Another option: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' TBS on the primary alcohol side chain. Third: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO' TBS on the secondary alcohol on ring.

We need 5 steps total. Likely steps: 1) deprotect TBS (reverse of protection). 2) maybe remove protecting group on side chain (if any). But we only need 5 steps total, so we need to design a plausible route: maybe start from simpler fragments: a cyclohexane diol core with side chain unsaturated chain and carboxylic acid.

We can propose retrosynthesis: target -> TBS-protected intermediate (step1). Then step2: break the side chain via HWE (Still-Gennari) to form aldehyde and phosphonate? Actually the side chain includes conjugated diene and carboxylic acid. Could be formed via Still-Gennari olefination of an aldehyde with a phosphonate to give (Z)-alkene. Also DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde. So steps: 2) reduce ester to aldehyde (DIBAL-H). 3) perform Still-Gennari HWE to install diene chain. 4) protect alcohols with TBS (but we already have). Maybe earlier steps: start from simple cyclohexanol and unsaturated acid.

We need to find templates for DIBAL-H reduction (ester to aldehyde). Search for functional groups broken: carboxylic esters, formed: aldehydes. Let's search.
